ADEVX-136 landed in PR navapbc/agentic-development-platform#24 against v0.3.1, ticket 451c-d340-ee65-41df closed cleanly with no force override.

Rebar defect 3 found and root-caused while unblocking it. Plan review criterion T1 (overlay-priorart) is the only criterion declaring web true. It routes to a local DuckDuckGo tool through ddgs. DDGS.text raises DDGSException "No results found." instead of returning an empty list, and its auto backend rotates across providers, several of which are blocked or throttled from this host. Measured on one query, auto ok, duckduckgo fail, google fail, bing ok, brave fail, mojeek fail. Neither rebar nor pydantic_ai catches DDGSException and there is no tool-call retry, so one unlucky query aborts an eight minute review with INDETERMINATE. Success measured around 40 percent per query. T1 is suppressed for bug type tickets, so only task tickets are exposed.

Confirmed a flake rather than a hard block. The review passed on retry 1 of an authorised budget of 2, signed, zero blocking, zero advisory, all 11 deterministic checks green.

Also learned that rebar review-plan --status and the close gate default --ref to origin/main, so a feature branch reads as stale-code until REBAR_GATE_REF or --ref names the branch head.

Full suite after the change, 1546 passed, 19 skipped, 0 failed.
